true,online-gathering,開源線上交流,Open-source online gathering,2026-11-14T13:00:00+08:00,2026-11-14T17:30:00+08:00,online,線上・Jitsi Meet,Online · Jitsi Meet,free,,,歡迎一起聊聊最近參與的開源專案。,Come share the open-source projects you have been working on.,"# 一起聊聊正在做的開源專案
這是一場**輕鬆的線上交流**。無論你正在維護專案、學習新工具，或只是想認識開源社群，都歡迎帶著問題加入。
## 可以分享什麼？
- 最近使用、正在貢獻或想推薦的開源工具。
- 開發過程遇到的小問題，以及你嘗試過的方法。
- 想徵求協作者的點子，不需要先準備投影片。
## 交流方式
1. 簡單介紹自己與感興趣的主題。
2. 自由分享，或在討論中提出問題。
3. 將延伸閱讀與專案連結留給其他參加者。
> 只想先聽聽也很歡迎，不需要具備特定技術背景。
想進一步認識社群，可以先看看 [COSCUP 官網](https://coscup.org/)。","# Share the open-source projects you are working on
This is a **casual online conversation**. Whether you maintain a project, are learning a new tool, or simply want to meet the community, you are welcome to bring your questions.
## What can you share?
- An open-source tool you use, contribute to, or would recommend.
- A small development problem and the approaches you have tried.
- An idea that could use collaborators. Slides are not required.
## How the conversation works
1. Introduce yourself and the topics you are interested in.
2. Share a project or ask questions during the discussion.
3. Leave useful reading and project links for other participants.
> You are also welcome to listen. No particular technical background is required.
To learn more about the community, visit the [COSCUP website](https://coscup.org/).",,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,false,,,,,,,,,,,,,,true,,
